QuestInfo.name: The First Awakening
QuestInfo.0:
Your dizziness worried Pan. 
You told him you were fine. 

It seems he also experienced that flash of old memories. 
...Did they come from a #bpast life#k?
QuestInfo.1:
Pan says you seem on edge.
He wants to help ease your worries. 

Focus on him.
QuestInfo.2:
Pan used his power to create a portal, inside which you saw a pleasant spring. 
Stepping through, you found yourself in a bright, watery glade.
In the center of that glade was the Great Tree, swaying gently in the wind.
Beneath that tree, within a giant lotus blossom, the Forest Master lay fast asleep. 
At your approach, she gently opened her eyes.
